title: Oda and Tokugawa gunners win the Battle of Nagashino
summary: Massed arquebusiers of Oda Nobunaga and Tokugawa Ieyasu, firing from behind wooden palisades, destroyed the cavalry charges of Takeda Katsuyori.
reason: Takeda Katsuyori had besieged Nagashino castle, and Nobunaga and Ieyasu marched to relieve it.
significance: It broke the Takeda clan and showed the decisive power of firearms in Japanese warfare.
